# Julian Winking

> Robotics, controls & machine learning student at ETH Zurich. Personal portfolio: https://winki.ng

## Links

- Website: https://winki.ng
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/julian-winking/
- GitHub: https://github.com/julianwinking

## Selected Projects

- [Visual Odometry Pipeline](https://github.com/julianwinking/visual-odometry-pipeline): Full monocular visual odometry system featuring sliding-window Bundle Adjustment and Loop Closure with Pose Graph Optimization. Implements KLT tracking and 5-point/P3P-RANSAC algorithms for robust trajectory estimation. Received the Best Project Award.
- [Satellite Docking](https://github.com/julianwinking/satellite-docking): Autonomous satellite docking using Sequential Convex Programming (SCvx) for trajectory optimization. Simulates dynamic environments and enforces safety constraints for precise, collision-free docking maneuvers.
- [Multi-Agent Goal Collection](https://github.com/julianwinking/multi-agent-goal-collection): Hierarchical coordination system for differential-drive fleets solving the Vehicle Routing Problem. Combines MILP-based task assignment with space-time reservation maps for collision-free trajectory planning.
- [Bachelor Thesis: Reducing the Influence of Model Mismatch in Bayesian Optimization Through Targeted Noise Injection](https://github.com/julianwinking/bachelor-thesis): Addressed model mismatch in Bayesian Optimization by introducing "Targeted Noise Injection," a data-centric strategy using a novel multiplicative Gaussian likelihood to selectively down-weight misleading observations.
- Physics-Based Snow Simulation for Event-Camera De-Snowing: Physics-based snow simulation pipeline for event-camera perception in autonomous driving. Ego-motion-aligned snowfall rendered at 1250 fps, converted to events via v2e, and merged with real DSEC driving streams for paired snowy/clean data with exact ground truth; training on it restores segmentation to near clear-weather level and improves object detection by 26% relative mAP.
- World Model: Robot learning project (details coming soon).

## Other Projects

- [Flappy Bird](https://github.com/julianwinking/dpoc-flappy-bird): Dynamic Programming and Optimal Control solution for the Flappy Bird game.
- [PID Controller Simulation Demo](https://winki.ng/projects/pid-demo/index.html): Browser-based control systems demo for tuning PID gains and observing system response.
- [GymTracker](https://data-science-club.de/gym-tracker/): Predictive web app forecasting university gym occupancy using real-time data and time-series analysis.
- [Banner Injector Extension](https://github.com/julianwinking/chrome-banner-injector): Chrome extension to inject custom banners into pages using JavaScript and CSS.
- [RWTH Notenstreicher](https://rwth-notenstreicher.streamlit.app/): Streamlit app that analyses transcripts and suggests module exclusions to maximise GPA.
